retrieved_context: Francesca Schiavone: Francesca Schiavone (] ; born 23 June 1980 in Milan) is an Italian tennis player who turned professional in 1998.  She won the 2010 French Open singles title, becoming the first Italian woman to win a Grand Slam event in singles.  She was also runner-up at the 2011 French Open.  Her career high ranking is world No. 4, achieved on 31 January 2011.  To date, Schiavone is the last one handed-backhand player to win a Grand Slam title on the women's tour.

Olga Morozova: Olga Vasilyevna Morozova (Russian: Ольга Васильевна Морозова ) (born 22 February 1949) is a retired female tennis player who competed for the Soviet Union.  She was the runner up in singles at the 1974 French Open and 1974 Wimbledon Championships.
